figures: 1. Figure 1: Overview of the ScaffoldSwap experimental framework. Three audio conditioning approaches—SSL features (WavLM), discrete speech units (HuBERT + k-means), and phoneme+timing (MFA)—are evaluated with a shared temporal convolutional decoder to isolate the effect of speech representation on 3D facial animation quality.
results_section: 1. The performance gap between discrete units and phoneme+timing is consistent but modest: 1.3% on BIWI (8.080 vs 8.188 × 10⁻⁶) and 0.5% on VOCASET (4.553 vs 4.575 × 10⁻⁶).
2. On BIWI, the gap (0.108 × 10⁻⁶) exceeds one standard deviation of discrete units (0.015 × 10⁻⁶) by a factor of 7.1×.
3. On VOCASET, the gap (0.022 × 10⁻⁶) exceeds one standard deviation (0.004 × 10⁻⁶) by 5.2×.
